sentences.text: The present applications under Section 438 of the Cr.P.C. seek anticipatory bail in FIR No. 632/2021 under Sections 498A/406/34 of the IPC, registered at P.S. Dwarka South.
The applicants, Mr. Davinder Kumar Bhuradiya and Ms. Premwati are father-in-law and mother-in-law respectively, of the complainant.
Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the parties have settled their dispute before the Counselling Cell, Family Courts, Dwarka South vide settlement deed dated 17.03.2022.

entities.text: Counselling Cell, Family Courts, Dwarka South

sentences.text: Learned APP for the State, on instructions from the Investigation Officer who is present in Court today, confirms the aforesaid fact.

The applicants are directed to be released on bail on them furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs. 25,000/-
with one surety of like amount to the satisfaction of the Investigating Officer/Arresting Officer further subject to following conditions:
